latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of kg-generator: generate comprehensive Knowledge Graphs from file: or http(s): URLs.
- Produces RDF-Turtle by default; supports JSON-LD and other RDF serializations on request.
- Curated prompt templates: Generic (JSON-LD for general web content) and Business & Market Analysis (RDF-Turtle with NAICS codes and extended structure for business/strategy content).
- Automatic template selection based on content type and user preference.
- Validates RDF/JSON-LD syntax before delivering output.
- Saves generated files using a consistent naming scheme in a specified directory.
